title: Contradictory evidence remains conflicting until explicit human resolution

given.records: same Plant and observation key have supported present and absent evidence
given.assessment: Plant State candidate references the opposing records

when.action: persist the classified conflict and attempt to confirm one side

then.conflict: the conflict remains visible and is not collapsed by recency or confidence
then.promotion_guard: confirmation is rejected until the unsupported opposite record is explicitly rejected or later authoritative evidence resolves it
then.authority: a valid Boss or Engineer review may then confirm trust but never grants Safety approval or creates an action task
